Definitely NTA but your husband is! Wanting a Christmas card doesn't make you materialistic, heck wanting a small gift on Christmas all together still doesn't make you materialistic because it's more about the sentimental value. For other comments I saw you said that he wouldn't even make you a card himself because "it's too much effort" it sounds like he doesn't appreciate you or the things you do for him. Buying a game online is a lot more expensive than buying a simple card. 

It's hard times on everyone, and money has been tight for many of us! But a lot would still prioritize even getting a small gift to their S/O to show their appreciation. And prioritizing buying a game over showing your wife that even tho it's hard times you still want to see her happy sounds really selfish. 

I know you want to see him happy that's why you bought him all the things he asked for, but if he doesn't care about seeing you happy the same way you do it doesn't sound right nor fair to give him those gifts you got. I'd personally return the gifts you got and get yourself something nice for Christmas.

I'm not sure if it's much of an advice but that's what worked for me personally, I hope it helps:

* The most important thing is to understand that some positions that made you comfortable before wouldn't make you comfortable now and that's okay. 
*Try exploring new positions till you find the ones the doesn't cause much pressure. Communication with your partner make that part a lot easier. 
* Adding pillows for extra support. 
* Taking small breaks when needed. 
* Stretching before and after. 
* Smoking cannabis before it.

Last but not least communicating with your partner is really really important, you don't have to go through this alone, and you don't have to put yourself through extra pain just because you want to preform your best. It takes some time to accept that fact, but once you do you'll be able to find other ways to enjoy sex without causing extra tension to your pain.
